packaging_mechanism_map.summary: Ordinary pip wheel stays EXACTLY the pure fallback. Setting SOLWEIG_LIGHT_PACKAGE_NATIVE=<staged generation dir> (build-time only; the runtime loader reads no env) turns setup.py into the native assembly: verify gate -> byte-identical staging -> build -> post-build wheel verification -> wheel deletion + loud failure on ANY violation.
packaging_mechanism_map.setup.py (NEW, thin shim): Wires cmdclass + distclass only; all logic in the tool home. _NativeAwareDistribution.has_ext_modules() flips pure->platlib for native requests (Root-Is-Purelib: false, platform tag). _GuardedBuildPy stages before data collection and unstages in finally; pure builds run the purity guard instead. _GuardedBdistWheel post-verifies every wheel produced by this build and DELETES + fails on violation. Deleting this file returns the pre-N8-41 pure build.
packaging_mechanism_map.experiments/optimization_v8/packaging/as: The assembly gate: (1) request resolution -- locked build output only, set-but-invalid fails loud; (2) build_native.verify_generation in full (schema, content-derived generation name, per-file sha256, sizes, Mach-O structural walk, .s FMA re-audit); (3) linked-image scan: otool -tV through build_native.fma_audit, >=1000 instruction lines non-vacuity pin, compiled positive control (cc -ffp-contract=fast a*b+c must yield >=1 fmadd hit or the host cannot package); (4) install-name gate: @rpath/<name> or bare basename admissible, absolute/foreign install names rejected; only /usr/lib/, /System/ or @ deps (no Homebrew/dev-tree paths); (5) byte-identical staging with member-hash proof; (6) post-build wheel verification (members byte-identical, RECORD digests present, wheel_tags.check_wheel_tags has_native_lib=True). CLI form for operator use and gate tests.

packaging_mechanism_map.install_name_@rpath_disposition: The staged candidate carries the B7 dev-parity bare-basename install name; the loader dlopens the packaged artifact by ABSOLUTE PATH inside package resources (native_handle._load_entries), and the only dependency is the system libSystem, so it resolves from site-packages as-shipped. The canonical @rpath/<name> wheel form is a ONE-FLAG rebuild at the driver (build_native.py --install-name @rpath/liblw_native_g8.dylib, mechanism already present) and is expected with the N8-50 re-freeze; the assembly gate accepts BOTH forms and rejects absolute/foreign ones. NO post-hoc install_name_tool mutation was performed: mutating the shipped bytes would break the manifest sha256 and the content-derived generation identity.
